an5.121:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an5.121:1.2: athakho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena gilānasālā tenupasaṅkami
an5.121:1.3: addasā kho bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ dubbalaṃ gilānakaṃ
an5.121:2.1: yaṃkañci bhikkhave dubbalaṃ gilānakaṃ pañca dhammā na vijahanti tassetaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ
an5.121:2.2: nacirasseva āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissati
an5.121:3.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu asubhānupassī kāye viharati āhāre paṭikkūlasaññī sabbaloke anabhiratasaññī sabbasaṃkhāresu aniccānupassī maraṇasaññā kho panassa ajjhattaṃ supaṭṭhitā hoti
an5.121:3.3: yaṃkañci bhikkhave dubbalaṃ gilānakaṃ ime pañca dhammā na vijahanti tassetaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ
an5.121:3.4: nacirasseva āsavānaṃ khayā …pe… sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissatīti.
